title: 976 造化天地975 大极仙门
content_zh:
萧中研说到此处，不由得轻轻白了一眼洛豪，那双明眸之中带着几分嗔怪，又夹杂着些许无奈，仿佛是在说"你这人怎么什么都不懂却偏偏还能修炼到这般境界"。
她稍稍正了正坐姿，将袖口拢了拢，这才继续往下开口，
"我父亲有一位至交好友，姓长孙，名吴景。这位长孙前辈不但是一名货真价实的大极仙人，修为深不可测，更是一位五品仙丹大师，在仙丹一道上的造诣远非寻常丹师可比。他在太始天的地位极高，即便是我父亲见了他，也是平辈论交，从不敢怠慢。而这位长孙前辈膝下有一名亲传弟子，叫做长孙吴明，也修习丹道，师承长孙吴景的衣钵，虽不知具体是几品仙丹师，但既然能被长孙前辈收为入室弟子，想来丹道上的底子定然不差。"
她说到这里，话音微微一顿，面上掠过一丝不太自然的神色，随即咬了咬唇，像是下了极大的决心才将后面的话说了出来，
"我父亲的意思，是要我嫁给那个长孙吴明。两家长辈情谊深厚，他们觉得这是亲上加亲的好事，可我自己……不愿意。"
洛豪听到这里，心里便已经有了大致的轮廓，他微微颔首，暗自琢磨着——萧中研这般大费周章地找上自己，软磨硬泡又施压又放软，甚至连圆珠的消息都搬出来当过筹码，绕了这么大的圈子，只怕最终还是绕回到那桩婚事上头。
她八成是想让自己假扮她的双修伴侣，然后带回去给她那位大极仙人父亲过目，好让老人家断了将她许配给长孙吴明的念头，这等把戏在修真界和仙界都不算新鲜，无非是用一个"已有道侣"的既成事实，来堵住长辈指婚的由头罢了。
不过为了稳妥起见，洛豪并没有急着把自己的猜测说出口。他只是在椅背上靠了靠，双手环抱于胸前，做出一副若有所思的模样，然后才慢悠悠地开口问了出来，
"按理说，仙门之中最讲究的便是门当户对，这桩婚事无论从哪个角度看，都是强强联手的上佳之选。那长孙吴明既是仙丹师，又师从大极仙人，前途不可限量。你父亲替你做这样的安排，也不算亏待了你，你为何偏偏不答应？"
这话问得直白，却也带着几分试探的意味，萧中研听了，那张白玉般的脸颊上竟浮现出一抹淡淡的红晕，从耳根一路蔓延到腮边，将她原本清冷矜持的气质冲淡了不少。
这是她与洛豪交谈至今，头一回露出这般扭捏的神情，仿佛被戳中了心底最柔软的那一处，她垂下眼帘，指尖不自觉地绞着袖口的衣料，沉默了好一会儿，才低声开口，
"我知道……从外人看来，那确实是一门好亲事。可是，我已经有了心上人了。"
洛豪微微一怔，这个回答倒是有些出乎他的预料，他原本以为萧中研只是单纯不想被人安排婚姻，却没想到背后竟还有这么一层缘故，他挑了挑眉，追问了出来，
"既然如此，那你为何不把你的心上人带回去给你父亲看？反倒来寻我这个外人冒充……你该不会是想让我去替你送死，等你父亲盛怒之下拿我开刀，你好趁机脱身吧？"
他这话说到后半截时，语气里已明显带上了几分警惕，甚至连坐姿都不自觉地绷紧了些许，目光也变得锐利了几分，这等可能性并非毫无根据——大极仙人的怒火，岂是他区区一个上仙初期修士承受得起的？若萧中研当真存了拿他当替罪羊的心思，那这笔交易便是一桩彻头彻尾的陷阱。
萧中研先是一愣，随即像是被他的话气到了一般，猛地抬头瞪了他一眼，脸上的红晕还没褪尽，却又添了几分愠色，
"你瞎说什么呢！我父亲虽然脾气大了些，但名门正派的风骨还是在的，岂会对你一个上仙修士动手？你也太高看自己了吧！我以性命担保，我父亲绝不可能因为你替我冒充道侣就把你怎么样。我之所以找你，而不是找骄才——骄才便是我的心上人——是因为他如今正在造化天地之中参加试炼，那地方一旦进去，不到时限根本出不来。而眼下我父亲那边催得急，必须在近期之内带着人回去见他一趟，我没有别的办法，这才不得不来求你帮忙。"
"等等。"
洛豪忽然抬手打断了她的话，原本还带着几分警惕的目光此刻却被另一件事吸引了注意，他微微眯起眼，身子朝前倾了倾，认真地问了出来，
"你方才说造化天地？那究竟是什么地方？"

他之所以对这四个字如此敏感，是因为听到"试炼"二字时，心头忽然一动，他如今正愁没有合适的炼体之地，自从体会过炼体带来的种种好处之后，他便一直在暗中寻找能够淬炼肉身的高阶场所，只是苦于始终找不到合适的地方，若这造化天地当真适合炼体，那对他来说简直是一个不可多得的天大机缘。
萧中研闻言，不由长长地叹了一口气，那声叹息里满是"又被你问住了"的无奈，她用手撑着额头，摇了摇头开口，
"我是真的越来越看不懂你了，你究竟是怎么修炼到上仙境界的？怎的仙界里这些寻常人都知道的事，你竟一件都不晓？"
洛豪也不辩解，只是尴尬地笑了笑，坦然受了她这句揶揄。
萧中研见他这副模样，也懒得再跟他计较，索性耐心解释，
"造化天地乃是下十一天域之中，最适合修士试炼的宝地，没有之一。那里面广袤无边，放眼望去尽是混沌未开的气息，天地不分，乾坤未立，四处都潜藏着难以预料的危机，稍有不慎便可能身死道消。可正因如此，那地方也是淬炼肉身、修炼法术、锤炼仙元的最佳熔炉，甚至连神识都可以在其中接受极限磨砺。下十一天域的修士但凡有些野心和胆气的，大多都会设法进入造化天地走上一遭，至于能在里面走到哪一步、收获多少，全看各人的造化和悟性了。"
她说到这里，眉眼间微微扬起一丝神采，仿佛想到了什么值得骄傲的事情，语气也轻快了几分，
content_en:
When Xiao Zhongyan said this, he couldn't help but roll his eyes at Luo Hao. There was a bit of anger in his bright eyes, mixed with a bit of helplessness, as if to say, "How come you don't understand anything but you can still cultivate to such a state?"
She straightened her sitting position slightly, pulled up her sleeves, and then continued to speak,
"My father has a close friend named Changsun, named Wu Jing. This senior Changsun is not only a genuine Great Immortal with unfathomable cultivation, he is also a fifth-grade elixir master. His attainments in elixirs are far beyond those of ordinary alchemists. His status in Taishitian is extremely high, even if my father met him He is also a peer, and he never dares to neglect. And this senior eldest grandson has a direct disciple, named eldest grandson Wu Ming, who also practices alchemy, and inherits the mantle of eldest grandson Wu Jing. Although he does not know the specific rank of immortal alchemy master, since he can be accepted as a disciple by senior eldest grandson, he must have a good foundation in alchemy. "
When she said this, her voice paused slightly, an unnatural look flashed across her face, and then she bit her lip, as if she had made great determination before speaking out the next words.
"My father's intention is for me to marry the eldest grandson Wu Ming. The two families have a deep friendship and they think it is a good thing to get married, but I... don't want to."
When Luo Hao heard this, he already had a rough outline in his mind. He nodded slightly and thought to himself - Xiao Zhongyan went to such great lengths to find him, put pressure on and softened him, and even brought out the news about Yuanzhu as a bargaining chip. After going in such a big circle, he was afraid that he would eventually get back to the marriage.
She most likely wanted to pretend to be her dual cultivator partner, and then take it back to her father, the Great Immortal, so that the old man would stop thinking of marrying her to his eldest grandson Wu Ming. This kind of trick is not new in the world of cultivation and immortality. It is nothing more than using the fait accompli of "already having a Taoist partner" to block the reason for the marriage proposed by the elders.
However, for the sake of safety, Luo Hao was not in a hurry to tell his guess. He just leaned back in the chair, folded his hands on his chest, and looked thoughtful, and then slowly asked,
"It stands to reason that the most important thing among immortals is to be well-matched. No matter how you look at it, this marriage is the best choice for a strong alliance. The eldest grandson Wu Ming is both an immortal alchemy master and a disciple of the Great Immortal, and his future is limitless. Your father made such an arrangement for you, which is not a injustice to you. Why didn't you agree?"
The question was straightforward, but also somewhat probing. After Xiao Zhongyan heard this, a faint blush appeared on her white jade cheeks, spreading from the roots of her ears to her cheeks, which diluted her original cold and reserved temperament.
This was the first time she had shown such a twitchy expression since her conversation with Luo Hao, as if she had been poked at the softest part of her heart. She lowered her eyes and twisted the material of her cuffs unconsciously with her fingertips. She was silent for a long time before speaking in a low voice,
"I know... From the outside, it looks like a good marriage. But, I already have a sweetheart."
Luo Hao was slightly startled. This answer was a bit beyond his expectation. He originally thought that Xiao Zhongyan simply did not want to be arranged for a marriage, but he did not expect that there was such a reason behind it. He raised his eyebrows and asked further,
"If that's the case, why didn't you take your sweetheart back to your father? Instead, you came to me, an outsider, to pretend to be... You don't want me to die for you, so that you can take the opportunity to escape when your father gets angry and kills me, right?"
In the second half of his words, his tone was obviously a little wary. He even tightened his posture unconsciously, and his eyes became sharper. This possibility is not unfounded - the anger of the Great Immortal is not that of a mere beginning immortal.Can the monks afford it? If Xiao Zhongyan really wanted to use him as a scapegoat, then this deal would be a complete trap.
Xiao Zhongyan was stunned for a moment, then seemed to be angered by his words. He suddenly raised his head and glared at him. The blush on his face had not faded away, but it added a bit of embarrassment.
"What nonsense are you talking about! Although my father has a bit of a temper, he still has the integrity of a well-known and upright family. How could he attack you, an immortal monk? You think too highly of yourself! I guarantee with my life that my father will never do anything to you just because you pretended to be a Taoist monk for me. The reason why I am looking for you is not to look for a arrogant person. ——Jiaocai is my sweetheart—because he is currently participating in the trial in the world of creation. Once he enters that place, he cannot get out before the time limit. And now my father is in a hurry and must take people back to see him in the near future. I have no other way, so I have to ask for your help. "
"Wait."
Luo Hao suddenly raised his hand to interrupt her. His originally vigilant eyes were attracted by another thing. He narrowed his eyes slightly, leaned forward, and asked seriously,
"You just said that heaven and earth were created? Where exactly is that place?"
The reason why he is so sensitive to these four words is because when he heard the word "trial", his heart suddenly moved. Now he is worried that there is no suitable place for body training. Ever since he experienced the various benefits brought by body training, he has been secretly looking for a high-level place that can temper the body, but he has never been able to find a suitable place. If this world is really suitable for body training, it is a rare opportunity for him.
When Xiao Zhongyan heard this, she couldn't help but let out a long sigh. The sigh was filled with the helplessness of "I've been asked again by you." She supported her forehead with her hands, shook her head and spoke,
"I really don't understand you more and more. How on earth did you cultivate to the realm of immortality? How come you don't know any of the things in the immortal world that ordinary people know?"
Luo Hao didn't defend himself, he just smiled awkwardly and accepted her teasing calmly.
Seeing his appearance, Xiao Zhongyan didn't bother to argue with him anymore and simply explained patiently,
"The world of creation is one of the eleven most precious places for monks to practice. It is vast and boundless, and everything you look at is filled with the unopened atmosphere of chaos. There is no distinction between heaven and earth, and the universe has not yet been established. Unforeseen crises lurk everywhere. If you are not careful, you may die. But because of this, that place is also tempered. The best furnace for physical body, practicing spells, and tempering immortality, and even spiritual consciousness can be trained to the extreme. Most of the monks in the Lower Heaven Realm who have some ambition and courage will try to enter the world of creation. As for how far they can go and how much they can gain, it all depends on their luck and understanding. "
When she said this, her brows and eyes raised slightly, as if she had thought of something worth being proud of, and her tone became a little lighter,
